title: Retrospective approval check
input:
From: Joanna Sandhu <joanna.sandhu@harbourline.example>
To: contract.approvals@harbourline.example
Date: 2026-09-11T23:25:00Z
Subject: Retrospective approval check
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8

Hi all,

Signed copy done; just need the approvals tidied up.

Apologies for the short ntoice - this has been sitting in my inbox.

Let me know if you need anything else from our side.

Contract number: AGR-12722
Supplier: Duxford Training Services Ltd

Thanks so muuch!
Joanna Sandhu
Analyst, Procurement
Harbourline Mutual Finance Ltd

arguments.summary: Contract AGR-12722 executed despite rejected approval workflow WFL-DE949059

outcome.conclusion: Contract AGR-12722 was executed on 2026-09-03 despite its approval workflow WFL-DE949059 having been explicitly rejected by Legal. The request for retrospective approval cannot be granted routinely and represents an unauthorized execution breach. The matter is referred to senior management and Legal counsel via review case RVW-D7CEB6-01 for formal breach determination.

recommendations: Escalate the governance breach to senior leadership and Head of Legal for review.
Halt any supplier commencement or onboarding activities under AGR-12722 pending legal resolution.
Investigate how signatory execution occurred without completed legal approval.
